header.name: Theatre Appreciation
header.description: Studying Theories propounded by Masters of Theatre and their lives and influences. The course is designed not only to give a theoretical appreciation of theatre but it will be largely interspersed with class room improvisations and voice and movement exercises so that the students have a hands-on understanding right from the start
prerequisites_desirable: An open mind and a desire to communicate
